tools.name: nuclei
tools.install: apt-get install -y nuclei  OR  go install github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/v3/cmd/nuclei@latest

tools.name: dirsearch
tools.install: apt-get install -y dirsearch  OR  pip3 install dirsearch

tools.name: subfinder
tools.install: apt-get install -y subfinder  OR  go install github.com/projectdiscovery/subfinder/v2/cmd/subfinder@latest

tools.name: amass
tools.install: apt-get install -y amass  OR  go install github.com/owasp-amass/amass/v4/...@master

tools.name: feroxbuster
tools.install: apt-get install -y feroxbuster  OR  curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/epi052/feroxbuster/main/install-nix.sh | bash

tools.name: httpx
